attemptHistory.explanation: The new test asserted fullscreenElement before the real asynchronous fullscreen request settled. Added an explicit observable wait; fullscreen had actually applied.
The new test assumed an ordinary jump would cross the opponent, and initiated it at a fixed distance. Runtime unchanged; the test was moved closer.

The closer setup still cannot cross with the current jump and separation rules. A Node investigation found a 104.04 px jump height versus the existing 110 px separation criterion. The browser test now verifies real movement and a jump, while a pure presentation test covers already-crossed coordinates; no combat rule changed.

observations: Opaque HUD above scene; complete stage fits desktop and fullscreen viewport
Circle/diamond and J1/J2 remain distinct in grayscale view
Mobile gauge values, alert text and unmasked stage remain readable without horizontal overflow
Default compact HUD remains inside original arena

limits: Grayscale inspection is an internal visual aid, not a simulation of every color-vision deficiency or a user study.
No claim of global palette accessibility or screen-reader playability.
changesNotMade: No art assets, engine, replay rules or attack data changed
No palette-specific color-vision simulation or user-study certification
